name: Oc xao bo toi
summary: Snails stir-fried with butter and garlic, with bánh mì on the side. An evening plate.
origin: Hoi An. The same 7 June 2023 list also names ốc hấp sả gừng and ốc xào me as evening plates.
howToEat: Eat it in the evening, with bánh mì to mop up the butter.
seoTitle: Oc xao bo toi — garlic snails in Hoi An
seoDescription: Ốc xào bơ tỏi in Hoi An is snails stir-fried with butter and garlic, eaten with bánh mì.
